identification: H. McHugh (Tasmanian art pottery, Launceston, 1930s) squat shouldered vase, cobalt blue with white streaked drip glaze, base incised 'H. McHugh 1933' and shape number 22. About 12-14 cm high judging by the scale (not stated). No damage seen in three photos; light crazing at base. Cobalt blue with white drip is a good colour but the form is a compact squat shape, not a tall twin-handled one.
